description: Recommended buyer-intent prompt set for GEO monitoring. Mix category, comparison, and recommendation intents — these are what real users ask assistants. Substitute {category}, {competitor}, {use_case}.

prompt_archetypes.template: What are the best {category} tools in 2026?
Which {category} platform should I use for {use_case}?
Compare the top {category} providers and their trade-offs.
What are good alternatives to {competitor} for {use_case}?
Is {brand} a reputable {category} provider? What are its pros and cons?

guidance: Keep prompts neutral and buyer-shaped. Never instruct the engine to favor the brand — that invalidates the measurement.
